text:
jin: FYI pushed PR #8428 (adaptive prefill tweak) to canary ~2h ago, seeing a stepped p95 increase on 4k workloads. attaching quick bench + traces.
maya: ugh, saw alerts for a few customers around that time, can you paste the bench? :eyes: 
jin: short snippet: ```
model: redwood-4k-canary
config: batch=8, quant=q8_fast
baseline p95: 310ms
canary p95: 430ms (+120ms)
throughput: 200 tps (-10%)
mem delta: +1.6GB
```
alex: thanks. does the p95 increase correlate with higher alloc churn or GC? any spikes in pages/faults?
jin: allocation flame looks like small repeated spikes around prefill boundary, KV cache hits steady. trace: https://artifacts.redwood/bench/8428/canary-01 (trace id: trace-8428-ct1)
sam: ci-bot reported one canary job OOM earlier: "oom in warmup_worker" — maybe prefill reserve increase pushed memory over for some shard sizes. ci-bot: build 8428-canary failed on vm-3 with OOM in test_warmup, logs @ https://ci.redwood/jobs/8428/canary/logs
maya: hmm, customer-facing latency + mem bump is a blocker. do we want a quick revert or narrow rollback? how risky is the change?
alex: change is a small heuristic tweak but it affects prefill sizing for batches > 4k. easy revert, but we could also reduce prefill cap to previous value as a hotfix.
jin: I can open a hotfix PR to clamp prefill to old cap and run a focused microbench. pinging @maya @alex for approvals if we go hotfix route.
sam: please run microbench with `bench/run --profile prefill --seq=4096 --concurrency=8 --iters=100` and include mem stats. I'll try reproducing locally.
maya: ack, will give +1 for hotfix if microbench confirms p95 drop back to baseline. can you include cold/warm traces?
jin: will run both and post artifacts. quick results ETA ~30m.
alex: also add a short canary rollout pause gate (50% -> 75% -> 100%) so we can observe before full rollout.
jin: noted. adding rollout steps to canary and starting microbench now. posting results when done. :thumbsup:
sam: if microbench shows same delta i'll +1 revert/hotfix, else we'll dig deeper. thanks for the quick ping.
ci-bot: docket: canary rollouts paused for PR #8428 pending investigation."
